query: Helicone OpenTelemetry OTLP endpoint LLM logging proxy
answer: Helicone supports OpenTelemetry for LLM logging via OTLP endpoint, enabling detailed observability and cost attribution. OpenTelemetry integration allows tracing and monitoring of LLM applications. Use environment variables to configure OTLP endpoint and API keys for authentication.
